# Eof

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

```blitzbasic
Eof stream%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("streams_eof_example.tmp")
WriteLine file, "a"
WriteLine file, "b"
CloseFile file
file = ReadFile("streams_eof_example.tmp")
While Not Eof(file)
	Print ReadLine$(file)
Wend
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "streams_eof_example.tmp"
```

```text
a
b
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | Int | required | The stream to check. |

**Returns:** 1 when a file has been read to its end, otherwise 0.
